name: cultural-travel-passport
description: 全国数字文化旅行护照的移动端交互原型

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:standalone
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:e2e
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests index.html *.js *.json README.md docs/*.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts tests index.html *.js *.json README.md docs/*.md
